mixed_v1.note: The fixed held-out set for the detector recipe (October 2026): whole recordings the network never trains on, mixed by source, camera and frame rate. prof_game4 is video17 to 23 and prof_game7 is video43 to 46 (video44 is a moving camera). The own-camera clips are listed one by one rather than as their group, because video11 and video12 share the group and their labels were never corrected: they are not ground truth and would be scored with the set. grid_match8: broadcast, moving camera, 60 FPS; grid_match16: daylight gravel, fixed camera, 60 FPS; grid_match22: night, fixed camera, 30 FPS, 110 absent-ball labels. 24 clips, about 9.0k labels, 495 of them absent-ball. The incumbent weights trained on video1 to 9, so their numbers on the own-camera clips are not held out; prof_game4, prof_game7 and the three grid clips are.
